en: A black-and-white waterfront scene of a small coastal town with wooden houses and boathouses along a quay. Several small boats and a sailing vessel lie in the calm harbor, with wooden piers extending into the water. In the background, steep rocky cliffs rise behind the town. The word "FJÄLLBACKA" appears in the lower-left corner and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 5408 appears in the lower-right corner.
